race.comment: CAMDEN COVE (3) was well supported on debut on the back of some strong trial form but just struggled to put it all together down the straight when looking a bit lost. Expecting sharp improvement with the blinkers going straight on. SPOKESPERSON (7) debuts and is a half-brother to the handy The Black Cloud (Joe Pride). Has come along nicely at the trials and should be taken seriously if there's market support. RAPID REIGNS (6) is a Wootton Bassett colt also on debut. Has worked well in readiness without impressing and is another that's worth a market watch. ALABAMA SHOWDOWN (1) strips fitter second-up and deserves following up as an each-way chance after finishing second behind an impressive Wyong winner.
